title: Customer Success & Onboarding
description: Design plans to get new clients to value quickly. Tests 30/60/90-day planning, health metrics, and churn prevention.

seo.overviewBody: Customer Success onboarding ensures new software clients adopt key features quickly to drive long-term retention. CS managers assess candidates on building 30-60-90 day onboarding plans, reducing Time-to-Value (TTV), tracking milestone completion, and constructing customer health scorecards.

deliverables.title: 1. Customer Onboarding Playbook & 30-60-90 Day Plan
deliverables.desc: Comprehensive onboarding roadmap detailing kick-off meeting agendas, milestone targets, and user training sessions.

deliverables.title: 2. Time-to-Value (TTV) Milestone Tracker
deliverables.desc: Tracker model measuring client progression from initial account setup to first key feature activation ('Value Moment').

deliverables.title: 3. Customer Health Scoring Model
deliverables.desc: Scoring framework evaluating client product usage frequency, license adoption, support ticket volume, and executive engagement.

faqs.question: What is Time-to-Value (TTV) in Customer Success?
faqs.answer: TTV measures the duration from customer sign-up or contract start until the customer experiences their first tangible business benefit ('Aha moment') from the product.

faqs.question: What key metrics belong in a Customer Health Score?
faqs.answer: Product login frequency, feature adoption depth, license utilization percentage, support ticket sentiment, executive sponsor engagement, and invoice payment history.

faqs.question: How do you prevent customer drop-off during onboarding?
faqs.answer: Establish clear milestone checklists, send proactive progress check-in emails, offer automated product walk-throughs, and schedule weekly milestone alignment calls.
